sources.title: Gartner: Preemptive cybersecurity to dominate 50% of security spend by 2030

claims_supported: 轉載：By 2030, preemptive cybersecurity solutions will account for 50% of IT security spending, up from less than 5% in 2024, replacing standalone detection and response (DR) solutions as the preferred approach.

轉載：Preemptive cybersecurity technologies use advanced AI and ML to anticipate and neutralize threats before they materialize; capabilities include predictive threat intelligence, advanced deception and automated moving target defense.
轉載 Carl Manion：new gold standard … global attack surface grid (GASG)；DR-based cybersecurity will no longer be enough；countermeasures that act preemptively and independently of humans.
轉載：by 2030 over 1 million documented cybersecurity CVEs, up 300% from about 277,000 in 2025.
轉載：shift toward agentic AI and DSLMs；vertical／application／threat-actor specialization；product leaders who fail to invest risk incidents and market-share losses within two to four years.
轉載 ACIS 為 GASG 先制的下一步，以及第二段 Manion 引言。
